source.notes: QC three transactions. Existing TchpQcOrder/Garment/Result tables are unchanged. New sibling TchpQcOrderAql + TchpQcGarmentInspection and children TchpQcOrderCert / TchpQcDefectRecord hold safety, AQL rollup, and visual defects. Floor flow: safety defects first (Critical stops the garment), then visual + 4-stage measurements (stages optional). Re-import after deleting TX_QcOrder* if units are missing (pack does not rebuild the unit tree on update). TargetMarket / AgeCategory are DDL fields bound to simple list entities QcTargetMarket / QcAgeCategory (stored InternalKey).

tables.name: TchpQcOrder
tables.description: QC order aggregate root (StyleSpecId == product ReferenceId)

tables.name: TchpQcOrderSize
tables.description: Selected QC sizes for an order

tables.name: TchpQcGarment
tables.description: Sampled garment; one physical SizeRunSizeId per garment

tables.name: TchpQcResult
tables.description: QC measurement per garment POM. SizeRunSizeId is a snapshot from the parent garment.

tables.name: TchpQcOrderAql
tables.description: 1:1 sibling of TchpQcOrder — market/age, Ac, fail counts. PK = QcOrderId.

tables.name: TchpQcOrderCert
tables.description: Order-level certificates / lab reports (CPC, GPSR, flammability, OEKO-TEX)

tables.name: TchpQcGarmentInspection
tables.description: 1:1 sibling of TchpQcGarment — inspection status and Critical/Major/Minor flags. PK = QcGarmentId.

tables.name: TchpQcDefectRecord
tables.description: Floor safety and visual defects per sampled garment (fail-only; no checklist rows)

views.name: View_TchpQcOrderAvailableSize
views.createOrAlterSql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.View_TchpQcOrderAvailableSize AS SELECT CAST(o.QcOrderId AS BIGINT) * 1000000000 + CAST(srs.SizeRunSizeId AS BIGINT) AS QcOrderAvailableSizeId, o.QcOrderId, o.StyleSpecId, srs.SizeRunId, srs.SizeRunSizeId, srs.SizeLabel, srs.SizeOrder, srs.IsActive FROM dbo.TchpQcOrder AS o INNER JOIN dbo.TchpStyleSpec AS ss ON ss.StyleSpecId = o.StyleSpecId INNER JOIN dbo.TchpSizeRunSize AS srs ON srs.SizeRunId = ss.SizeRunId WHERE ISNULL(srs.IsActive, 1) = 1

views.name: View_TchpQcOrderPom
views.createOrAlterSql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.View_TchpQcOrderPom AS SELECT CAST(o.QcOrderId AS BIGINT) * 1000000000 + CAST(psl.PomSpecLineId AS BIGINT) AS QcOrderPomId, o.QcOrderId, psl.PomSpecLineId, psl.StyleSpecId, ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(psl.BodypartAliasName)), N''), bp.BodyPartName) AS PomName, bp.BodyPartName, psl.BodypartAliasName, psl.Sort, psl.BaseValue, psl.Tolerance FROM dbo.TchpQcOrder AS o INNER JOIN dbo.TchpPomSpecLine AS psl ON psl.StyleSpecId = o.StyleSpecId INNER JOIN dbo.TchpBodyPart AS bp ON bp.BodyPartId = psl.BodyPartId

views.name: View_TchpQcOrderPomSizeResult
views.createOrAlterSql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.View_TchpQcOrderPomSizeResult AS SELECT CAST(o.QcOrderId AS BIGINT) * 1000000000000 + CAST(psl.PomSpecLineId AS BIGINT) * 1000000 + CAST(os.SizeRunSizeId AS BIGINT) AS QcOrderPomSizeId, CAST(o.QcOrderId AS BIGINT) * 1000000000 + CAST(psl.PomSpecLineId AS BIGINT) AS QcOrderPomId, o.QcOrderId, psl.PomSpecLineId, os.SizeRunSizeId, srs.SizeLabel, srs.SizeOrder, COUNT(r.QcResultId) AS SampleCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.[Pass] = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FailCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.[Pass] = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PassCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.[Pass] IS NULL AND r.QcResultId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PendingCount, AVG(r.FinalDiff) AS AvgFinalDiff FROM dbo.TchpQcOrder AS o INNER JOIN dbo.TchpQcOrderSize AS os ON os.QcOrderId = o.QcOrderId INNER JOIN dbo.TchpSizeRunSize AS srs ON srs.SizeRunSizeId = os.SizeRunSizeId INNER JOIN dbo.TchpPomSpecLine AS psl ON psl.StyleSpecId = o.StyleSpecId LEFT JOIN dbo.TchpQcGarment AS g ON g.QcOrderId = o.QcOrderId AND g.SizeRunSizeId = os.SizeRunSizeId LEFT JOIN dbo.TchpQcResult AS r ON r.QcGarmentId = g.QcGarmentId AND r.PomSpecLineId = psl.PomSpecLineId GROUP BY o.QcOrderId, psl.PomSpecLineId, os.SizeRunSizeId, srs.SizeLabel, srs.SizeOrder

views.name: View_TchpQcOrderDefectSummary
views.createOrAlterSql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.View_TchpQcOrderDefectSummary AS SELECT CAST(g.QcOrderId AS BIGINT) * 1000000000 + CAST(d.QcDefectRecordId AS BIGINT) AS QcOrderDefectId, g.QcOrderId, d.QcDefectRecordId, g.QcGarmentId, g.GarmentSerial, d.DefectClass, d.DefectCode, d.DefectLocation, d.Quantity, d.Description, d.InspectionTrack FROM dbo.TchpQcDefectRecord AS d INNER JOIN dbo.TchpQcGarment AS g ON g.QcGarmentId = d.QcGarmentId

views.name: View_TchpProductQcSummary
views.createOrAlterSql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.View_TchpProductQcSummary AS SELECT ss.StyleSpecId, COUNT(o.QcOrderId) AS OrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatus = N'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PassedOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatus = N'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FailedOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatus IN (N'OPEN', N'IN_PROGRESS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OpenOrderCount, SUM(ISNULL(a.FailCriticalCount, 0)) AS FailCriticalCount, SUM(ISNULL(a.FailMajorCount, 0)) AS FailMajorCount, SUM(ISNULL(a.FailMinorCount, 0)) AS FailMinorCount FROM dbo.TchpStyleSpec AS ss LEFT JOIN dbo.TchpQcOrder AS o ON o.StyleSpecId = ss.StyleSpecId LEFT JOIN dbo.TchpQcOrderAql AS a ON a.QcOrderId = o.QcOrderId GROUP BY ss.StyleSpecId

transactions.name: QC Order
transactions.description: QC order header + AQL sibling, certs, sampled garments, defect rollup, POM×Size pivot

commands.name: _Recalc AQL Status
_Seed Required Certs
commands.sqlStatement:
IF CAST([TF:TchpQcOrder.QcOrderId] AS INT) IS NULL
BEGIN
    RAISERROR(N'Save the QC Order first.', 16, 1);
    RETURN;
END

DECLARE @Oid INT = CAST([TF:TchpQcOrder.QcOrderId] AS INT);
DECLARE @Mkt NVARCHAR(20);
DECLARE @Age NVARCHAR(20);
SELECT
    @Mkt = COALESCE(mkt.Code, a.TargetMarket),
    @Age = COALESCE(age.Code, a.AgeCategory)
FROM dbo.TchpQcOrderAql AS a
LEFT JOIN dbo.AppEntityInfo AS eiM ON eiM.EntityCode = N'QcTargetMarket'
LEFT JOIN dbo.AppEntitySimpleListValue AS mkt
    ON mkt.EntityInfoID = eiM.EntityInfoID
   AND (CAST(mkt.InternalKey AS NVARCHAR(20)) = a.TargetMarket OR mkt.Code = a.TargetMarket)
LEFT JOIN dbo.AppEntityInfo AS eiA ON eiA.EntityCode = N'QcAgeCategory'
LEFT JOIN dbo.AppEntitySimpleListValue AS age
    ON age.EntityInfoID = eiA.EntityInfoID
   AND (CAST(age.InternalKey AS NVARCHAR(20)) = a.AgeCategory OR age.Code = a.AgeCategory)
WHERE a.QcOrderId = @Oid;

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TchpQcOrderAql WHERE QcOrderId = @Oid)
    INSERT INTO dbo.TchpQcOrderAql (QcOrderId, AcCritical, AppCreatedDate) VALUES (@Oid, 0, GETDATE());

;WITH req AS (
    SELECT N'CPC' AS CertType, CAST(CASE WHEN @Age IN (N'INFANT', N'CHILD', N'SLEEPWEAR') AND @Mkt IN (N'US', N'US_EU') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsRequired
    UNION ALL SELECT N'GPSR_RP', CAST(CASE WHEN @Mkt IN (N'EU', N'US_EU') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)
    UNION ALL SELECT N'FLAM_1615', CAST(CASE WHEN @Age = N'SLEEPWEAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)
    UNION ALL SELECT N'FLAM_1610', CAST(0 AS BIT)
    UNION ALL SELECT N'OEKOTEX', CAST(0 AS BIT)
)
MERGE dbo.TchpQcOrderCert AS t
USING req AS s
    ON t.QcOrderId = @Oid AND t.CertType = s.CertType
WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET IsRequired = s.IsRequired,
               Result = CASE WHEN s.IsRequired = 1 AND t.Result = N'NA' THEN N'PENDING' WHEN s.IsRequired = 0 AND t.Result IN (N'PENDING', N'MISSING') THEN N'NA' ELSE t.Result END,
               AppModifiedDate = GETDATE(), AppModifiedById = [CurrentUserId]
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
    INSERT (QcOrderId, CertType, Result, IsRequired, AppCreatedById, AppCreatedDate)
    VALUES (@Oid, s.CertType, CASE WHEN s.IsRequired = 1 THEN N'PENDING' ELSE N'NA' END, s.IsRequired, [CurrentUserId], GETDATE());

transactions.name: QC Garment Result
transactions.description: One garment: safety/visual defects first, then 4-stage POM measurements. Critical stops remaining checks.

fields.ddlQueryText: SELECT srs.SizeRunSizeId, srs.SizeLabel FROM dbo.TchpQcOrderSize AS os INNER JOIN dbo.TchpSizeRunSize AS srs ON srs.SizeRunSizeId = os.SizeRunSizeId WHERE os.QcOrderId = @p0 ORDER BY srs.SizeOrder, srs.SizeLabel

SELECT c.DefectCode, c.DisplayName FROM dbo.TchpQcDefectCode AS c INNER JOIN dbo.TchpQcGarment AS g ON g.QcGarmentId = @p0 LEFT JOIN dbo.TchpQcOrderAql AS a ON a.QcOrderId = g.QcOrderId LEFT JOIN dbo.AppEntityInfo AS eiM ON eiM.EntityCode = N'QcTargetMarket' LEFT JOIN dbo.AppEntitySimpleListValue AS mkt ON mkt.EntityInfoID = eiM.EntityInfoID AND (CAST(mkt.InternalKey AS NVARCHAR(20)) = a.TargetMarket OR mkt.Code = a.TargetMarket) LEFT JOIN dbo.AppEntityInfo AS eiA ON eiA.EntityCode = N'QcAgeCategory' LEFT JOIN dbo.AppEntitySimpleListValue AS age ON age.EntityInfoID = eiA.EntityInfoID AND (CAST(age.InternalKey AS NVARCHAR(20)) = a.AgeCategory OR age.Code = a.AgeCategory) WHERE ISNULL(c.IsActive, 1) = 1 AND c.InspectionTrack IN (N'SAFETY', N'VISUAL') AND (c.AppliesMarket = N'ALL' OR c.AppliesMarket = ISNULL(COALESCE(mkt.Code, a.TargetMarket), N'ALL') OR (ISNULL(COALESCE(mkt.Code, a.TargetMarket), N'') = N'US_EU' AND c.AppliesMarket IN (N'US', N'EU'))) AND (c.AppliesAge = N'ALL' OR c.AppliesAge = ISNULL(COALESCE(age.Code, a.AgeCategory), N'ALL') OR (c.AppliesAge = N'CHILD' AND ISNULL(COALESCE(age.Code, a.AgeCategory), N'') IN (N'INFANT', N'CHILD', N'SLEEPWEAR'))) ORDER BY c.DefectClass, c.DefectCode

commands.name: _Sync POM From Grading
commands.sqlStatement:
IF CAST([TF:TchpQcGarment.QcGarmentId] AS INT) IS NULL
BEGIN
    RAISERROR(N'Save the garment first.', 16, 1);
    RETURN;
END

IF CAST([TF:TchpQcGarment.SizeRunSizeId] AS INT) IS NULL
BEGIN
    RAISERROR(N'Select Size before reloading POM list.', 16, 1);
    RETURN;
END

IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TchpQcGarmentInspection
    WHERE QcGarmentId = CAST([TF:TchpQcGarment.QcGarmentId] AS INT)
      AND InspectionStatus = N'STOPPED_CRITICAL'
)
BEGIN
    RAISERROR(N'Critical defect recorded — measurement skipped.', 16, 1);
    RETURN;
END

;WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        CAST([TF:TchpQcGarment.QcGarmentId] AS INT) AS QcGarmentId,
        psl.PomSpecLineId,
        CAST([TF:TchpQcGarment.SizeRunSizeId] AS INT) AS SizeRunSizeId,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(psl.IsFixed, 0) = 1 THEN psl.BaseValue
                ELSE psl.BaseValue + ISNULL((
                    SELECT SUM(gv.GradingDelta)
                    FROM dbo.TchpGradeValue AS gv
                    INNER JOIN dbo.TchpSizeRunSize AS srs
                        ON srs.SizeRunSizeId = gv.SizeRunSizeId
                    WHERE gv.PomSpecLineId = psl.PomSpecLineId
                      AND srs.SizeRunId = ss.SizeRunId
                      AND (
                            (tgt.SizeOrder > baseSz.SizeOrder
                             AND srs.SizeOrder > baseSz.SizeOrder
                             AND srs.SizeOrder <= tgt.SizeOrder)
                         OR (tgt.SizeOrder < baseSz.SizeOrder
                             AND srs.SizeOrder >= tgt.SizeOrder
                             AND srs.SizeOrder < baseSz.SizeOrder)
                      )
                ), 0)
            END AS DECIMAL(10,3)
        ) AS SpecValue,
        CAST(COALESCE(psl.Tolerance, bp.Tolerance, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS Tolerance
    FROM dbo.TchpQcOrder AS o
    INNER JOIN dbo.TchpStyleSpec AS ss
        ON ss.StyleSpecId = o.StyleSpecId
    INNER JOIN dbo.TchpPomSpecLine AS psl
        ON psl.StyleSpecId = ss.StyleSpecId
    INNER JOIN dbo.TchpSizeRunSize AS baseSz
        ON baseSz.SizeRunSizeId = ss.BaseSizeDetailId
    INNER JOIN dbo.TchpSizeRunSize AS tgt
        ON tgt.SizeRunSizeId = CAST([TF:TchpQcGarment.SizeRunSizeId] AS INT)
    LEFT JOIN dbo.TchpBodyPart AS bp
        ON bp.BodyPartId = psl.BodyPartId
    WHERE o.QcOrderId = CAST([TF:TchpQcGarment.QcOrderId] AS INT)
      AND psl.BaseValue IS NOT NULL
)
MERGE dbo.TchpQcResult AS t
USING src
    ON t.QcGarmentId = src.QcGarmentId
   AND t.PomSpecLineId = src.PomSpecLineId
WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET
        SizeRunSizeId = src.SizeRunSizeId,
        SpecValue = src.SpecValue,
        Tolerance = src.Tolerance,
        AppModifiedDate = GETDATE(),
        AppModifiedById = [CurrentUserId]
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
    INSERT (
        QcGarmentId, PomSpecLineId, SizeRunSizeId,
        SpecValue, Tolerance,
        AppCreatedById, AppCreatedDate
    )
    VALUES (
        src.QcGarmentId, src.PomSpecLineId, src.SizeRunSizeId,
        src.SpecValue, src.Tolerance,
        [CurrentUserId], GETDATE()
    );

DELETE r
FROM dbo.TchpQcResult AS r
WHERE r.QcGarmentId = CAST([TF:TchpQcGarment.QcGarmentId] AS INT)
  AND (
        r.SizeRunSizeId <> CAST([TF:TchpQcGarment.SizeRunSizeId] AS INT)
     OR NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.TchpQcOrder AS o
            INNER JOIN dbo.TchpPomSpecLine AS psl
                ON psl.StyleSpecId = o.StyleSpecId
            WHERE o.QcOrderId = CAST([TF:TchpQcGarment.QcOrderId] AS INT)
              AND psl.PomSpecLineId = r.PomSpecLineId
              AND psl.BaseValue IS NOT NULL
        )
  );
